checks.description: with the gateway down the sandbox loses outbound access (fails closed)
checks.because: The only route out is the gateway; with no gateway there is no route.

checks.description: when the gateway returns the same sandbox reaches its allowed host again
checks.because: Nothing in the sandbox had to change.

checks.description: with the sandbox controller down, a running session keeps working
checks.because: The controller only reconciles claims; the sandbox and its router path do not depend on it.
